crossRefs.note: Afterward he was revealed to the eleven themselves as they sat at the table, and he rebuked them for their unbelief and…
Jesus answered them, “Didn’t I choose you, the twelve, and one of you is a devil?”
When they had come in, they went up into the upper room where they were staying; that is Peter, John, James, Andrew…
Yes, we are also found false witnesses of God, because we testified about God that he raised up Christ, whom he didn’t…
Go quickly and tell his disciples, ‘He has risen from the dead, and behold, he goes before you into Galilee; there you…
Then Jesus said to them, “Don’t be afraid. Go tell my brothers that they should go into Galilee, and there they will…
But after I am raised up, I will go before you into Galilee.”

people.name: Galilee

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: But the eleven disciples went into Galilee, to the mountain where Jesus had sent them.
translations.bsb: Meanwhile, the eleven disciples went to Galilee, to the mountain Jesus had designated.
translations.kjv: Then the eleven disciples went away into Galilee, into a mountain where Jesus had appointed them.
translations.asv: But the eleven disciples went into Galilee, unto the mountain where Jesus had appointed them.
